page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is an x86_64 bare-metal GPU-accelerated instance engineered for compute-heavy parallel workloads and graphical processing. The system architecture provides 128 dedicated vCPUs paired with 768.0 GB of system memory, delivering a ratio of 6.0 GB RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is anchored by four NVIDIA A10 GPUs providing a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM across the four devices.

The instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to facilitate rapid data movement and distributed cluster communication. The hardware platform includes no local disk storage, meaning that all persistent file systems and operating system installations require remote network-attached block storage volumes. Zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to the instance profile.

With its dense combination of dedicated central processing cores, 768 GB of host memory, and four dedicated accelerators, the ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is architected for machine learning inference, computer vision processing, cloud rendering, digital media encoding, and distributed scientific simulations.
